dedupe_keys.name: industrial symbiosis hold up agent based model

description: This NetLogo model explores the hold-up problem in industrial-symbiosis networks. Its README describes producers and consumers investing in green technology while market turbulence, contract strength and reputation memory affect continued exchange. Users configure those institutional and economic assumptions in NetLogo BehaviorSpace; outputs are simulated network relationships and experiment tables, with Python scripts for phase-transition plots. Geographic coverage is a synthetic industrial network, not a specific site. GitHub metadata and the README state MIT licensing. A limitation is that the repository omits large generated experiment CSVs, and the README's substantive conclusions are model results, not observed industrial behaviour. The model can explore institutional fragility in energy or materials-exchange infrastructure. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model optimises energy supply; this model represents partner behaviour. No experiment table or software was downloaded.
inputs: Synthetic producer-consumer network, contract and market settings
name: Industrial Symbiosis hold-up agent-based model
notes: G7 G7-1957. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
outputs: Partner relationships and simulated network survival
